name: postdate
description: Write a message now, have it delivered later. Self-hosted on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json

SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts saved channel credentials. Use a long random string, for example the output of `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep it: losing it means re-entering every channel.
